title: Jeremy Dennis
summary: Jeremy Dennis is the Creator of On This Site and a Shinnecock Tribal Member. He is a contemporary fine art photographer whose work uses photography, mapped places, research, and public storytelling to document Native Long Island.
content:
Jeremy Dennis (b. 1990) is a contemporary fine art photographer and enrolled Tribal Member of the Shinnecock Indian Nation in Southampton, New York. He is the founder and lead artist of Ma's House & BIPOC Art Studio, Inc., an artist-led nonprofit art space and residency on the Shinnecock Reservation.1

His practice brings together staged photography, landscape, archival research, installation, public history, and community-based projects to examine Indigenous identity, memory, land, and the continuing presence of Native histories on Long Island.1

On This Site - Native Long Island is one of Dennis's ongoing projects, using photography, mapping, and research to document culturally significant Native American sites across Long Island. He received Running Strong for American Indian Youth Dreamstarter support for On This Site in 2016.1

Dennis holds an MFA from Pennsylvania State University and a BA in Studio Art from Stony Brook University, and lives and works in Southampton, New York, on the Shinnecock Indian Reservation.1
why_this_matters: Jeremy Dennis created On This Site as a Shinnecock-led public map, photography, and research project. His biography makes the project authorship visible and connects contemporary Native presence, art, and community memory.
